title: Tax Compliance Analyst
description:
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  

  

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.


**About the Global Business Services**
--------------------------------------


Our Finance team is not just another department; we're strategic partners and catalysts for change, who use our expertise to drive sustainable growth and create and protect value Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS). Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co\-creativity \- while learning together \- OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast\-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back\-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission


**About the role**
------------------


As a Tax Compliance Analyst you will report to the Tax Compliance Assistant Manager, supporting tax compliance and reporting activities across the regions including Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia and Latvia. You will prepare and review tax filings, analyse tax positions, and provide insights to support business decisions. This is a cross\-functional role covering a variety of Direct \& Indirect Tax matters, and you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams and develop your expertise in a dynamic, global environment.


**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Support preparation and review of tax returns and supporting documentation.
* Review of tax returns prepared by an Outsource Partner (Big4 firm).
* Prepare and support group tax reporting into Longview.
* Assist in gathering and analyzing financial data for tax reporting and compliance.
* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure accurate and timely tax submissions.
  
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or tax
* 3 \- 5 years of experience in tax compliance or analysis
* Strong technical knowledge of tax regulations and reporting
* Experience in Share service centers desired
* Advanced English; other languages is a plus
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Experience with SAP and tax compliance software
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities
**The skills for success**
--------------------------


Tax Law, Tax Compliance, Project management, Improve business processes, Communication Skills.


**What we offer**
-----------------


With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.


We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt’s potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt’s pay for performance philosophy.


**Equality**
------------


We recognise that in real life, great people don’t always ‘tick all the boxes’. That’s why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don’t meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Senior Lead Business Execution Consultant - Project Management / Compliance
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Business Execution Consultant

 **In this role, you will:**

* Act as a Business Execution advisor to Compliance leadership to drive performance and initiatives, and develop and implement information delivery or presentations to key stakeholders and senior management
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges related to Business Execution that require solid analytical skills, extensive knowledge of Business Execution, and understanding of business, delivering longer term and large scale solutions
* Provide vision, direction, and expertise to senior leadership for implementing innovative and significant business solutions that are large scale and cross organizational
* Lead team meetings or steering committee to facilitate decision making and support implementation of recommendations and plans
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across multiple lines of businesses and serve as an experienced advisor to the leadership
* Provide direction to a cross functional team using business expertise

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Should have strong project management, excellent communication and influential stakeholder management skills
* Should be able to read data
* Hands\-on experience in capacity planning, Workforce management, P\&L etc.,

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Understanding of Compliance Function, Risk \& Control framework

* The role will be a single point of contact for multiple/all sub\-service functions within Compliance delivered from the region.This individual will act as an advisor to develop and/or influence plans, specifications, resource needs, workforce management and execute other strategic priorities for Compliance. The role will provide direction and expertise to senior leadership on implementing significant business solutions working with the peer groups with our US teams and support strategically engaging all managers in the region in driving the capacity planning as well as other projects for the functions.The individual will act as a PMO and strategic partner to drive the priorities with right rigor, independent assessment as well as with a consistent approach on workforce planning.

2 Oct 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

title: Senior Manager - Global Supply Chain Compliance
description:
Overview:

The Global Supply Chain Compliance Analyst role partners with sector cyber risk owners to drive sector supply chain compliance to Information Security Policy and OT\-specific standards and controls. This role will ensure OT controls testing and compliance initiatives are completed and will guide risk owners through Information Security OT exception process. The role will provide support for process improvement initiatives through analysis, documentation, and testing.

  


Responsibilities:  

* Provide training and insights to Sector OT Leads on OT cybersecurity standards, controls, compliance, metrics, and reporting
* Partner with OT Sector Leads to drive compliance to PepsiCo OT\-specific standards and controls
* Monitor and drive control testing at local plants (i.e., anti\-virus, system patching, backups, recovery and reconstitution, asset inventory)
* Guide OT Sector Leads to submit and monitor information security exceptions and risk remediations
* Review supplier compliance to PepsiCo standards and services; recommend performance improvements
* Partner with InfoSec to provide OT\-specific requirements related to process design and modifications
* Analyze OT cybersecurity metrics; Provide report requirements that identify global and sector cyber risks
* Ensure OT reporting and dashboard metrics are accurate through data validation
* Provide manager insight to sector and plant risk issues and risk mitigations; Recommend actions for improvement

  


Qualifications:  

* Proficient in Microsoft PowerBI as end\-user
* Proficient in Microsoft suite of tools – Excel (pivot tables), Word, PowerPoint,
* Proficient in search engines and research
* Experience partnering and collaborating with global teams having various responsibilities
* Understanding of data privacy, regulations, and laws and how they apply to cybersecurity controls
* Working knowledge of control development processes including design, documentation, testing, and maintenance
* Ability to drive improvements in internal and external partners
* Strong process efficiency and procedure development skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong people skills communicating across different experience levels
* Ability to drive results and build consensus with stakeholders
* Ability to analyze situations, evaluate multiple perspectives, collect evidence, ask questions, and use critical thinking skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills

title: Legal Associate - Corporate Laws
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented **Corporate Legal Associate** to join our legal team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing legal support across a broad range of corporate matters including contracts, compliance, structuring, mergers \& acquisitions, and regulatory affairs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Bar Council registered Advocate, who can serve the legal notice and can appear in NCLT.
* Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements including MSAs, NDAs, SLAs, vendor/supplier contracts, and investor documents (SHA, SSA, etc.)
* Assist in structuring and executing corporate transactions such as M\&A, private equity/venture capital deals, and joint ventures.
* Conduct legal due diligence and prepare reports or red flag summaries for transactions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable corporate laws, SEBI/ROC regulations, FEMA guidelines, and other relevant legal frameworks.
* Support corporate governance activities including board meetings, resolutions, and secretarial documentation.
* Advise internal teams and stakeholders on contract risks, dispute mitigation, and legal strategies.
* Liaise with external counsel, regulatory authorities, and government agencies as required.
* Maintain a centralized repository for legal documents and ensure version control.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LL.B.) from a recognized university; LL.M. or CS qualification is a plus.
* \[2–5] years of experience in corporate legal work (preferably in a law firm ).
* Solid understanding of Companies Act, Contract Act, FEMA, and other relevant regulations.
* Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously under tight deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with private equity / venture capital transactions or startup ecosystem.
* Exposure to cross\-border transactions and international legal frameworks.
* Proficiency in legal research tools (Manupatra, SCC, etc.) and Microsoft Office Suite.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: From ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

* Leads end to end contracting related to clinical, commercial, corporate vendor contracts for products and services including but not limited to reviewing and negotiating sophisticated service agreements, Licensing, SaaS, HR \& staffing agreements and other contracts, including strategic alliances, data privacy related agreements as well as various issues escalated from the business units and internal departments.

* Liaise with other global legal members and other departments to provide responsive legal support.
* Trains internal employees and managements on various legal matters and increase awareness on legal, new hire orientations and consultations.
* Conducts legal research and analysis related to the company’s business.

**Additional Qualifications**

* JD/LLM/LLB or an equivalent Degree from an accredited University.
* Fully Qualified lawyer.
* Proven experience in a worldwide company or an international company.
* Strong Knowledge and experience in a broad range of areas of law.
* Strong knowledge of contracts and commercial laws in assigned region/country.
* Ability to collaborate with colleagues and take a business\-oriented approach while identifying and balancing legal risks and providing succinct, accurate and pragmatic advice.
* Ability to work independently while being able to contribute successfully to cross\-functional teams.
* Outstanding relationship\-building skills.
* Exceptional analytical skills, independent judgment, a desire to learn, and an ability to take on and prioritize a wide variety of complex matters.

description:

* Travel allowances and accommodations
* Learning \& development programs
* Exposure to high\-level strategic work and global operations

title: Company Secretary
description:
**Job Title: Company Secretary**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Company Secretary** to join our organization. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **corporate governance, statutory compliance, legal and regulatory requirements, cost management, and board administration**.

The Company Secretary will work closely with the **Board of Directors, senior management, shareholders, regulators, auditors, and external legal advisers** to ensure that the organization operates efficiently, transparently, and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corporate Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements.
* Maintain and update the company's statutory books, registers, records, and corporate documents.
* Monitor changes in legislation and regulatory requirements and ensure timely implementation of necessary actions.
* Ensure company policies and governance frameworks are current, compliant, and appropriately approved.
* Develop and implement processes and systems to strengthen compliance and organizational governance.

**Board \& Shareholder Management**

title: Compliance Senior Manager - Trade and Communication Surveillance Oversight
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Compliance Senior Manager

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage and lead team with the implementation of the companywide compliance program with moderate to high risk complexity
* Establish, implement, and maintain risk standards and programs to drive compliance with federal, state, agency, legal and regulatory and Corporate Policy requirements
* Provide compliance risk and regulatory expertise for compliance program elements
* Identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement and risk control development
* Lead the reporting, escalation, and timely remediation of issues, deficiencies or regulatory matters regarding compliance risk management
* Report on the Compliance Program to more experienced compliance leaders, committees, and appropriate business management
* Make decisions and resolve issues to meet business objectives
* Interpret policies, procedures, and compliance requirements
* Collaborate and influence all levels of professionals including managers
* Build relationships with corporate, business leaders, Legal, Audit, regulators and industry partners on risk related topics
* Lead team to achieve objectives
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Compliance
* Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Compliance experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* 12\+ years of experience in Compliance, Market Conduct, Surveillance or related control functions.
* Significant experience managing Trade Surveillance and/or Communications Surveillance programs within a global financial institution.
* Proven people leadership experience managing teams across multiple compliance disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience engaging with senior stakeholders across global organizations.
* Experience supporting regulatory examinations, audits, and compliance reviews.
* Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements relating to market conduct and surveillance.
* Experience overseeing multiple surveillance pillars simultaneously.
* Experience leading global operating model transformation initiatives.
* Experience implementing surveillance technologies, automation, analytics, or AI\-driven monitoring solutions.
* Experience establishing or scaling Centres of Excellence and offshore capability centres.
* Exposure to SEC, FCA, FINRA, MiFID, MAR, and related regulatory frameworks is preferrable.
* **Critical Competencies**

**Leadership**
* Strategic thinking
* Executive presence
* Decision\-making under ambiguity
* Change leadership
* Talent development
* **Functional Expertise**
* Trade Surveillance
* E\-Communications Surveillance
* Voice Surveillance
* Market Abuse Risk
* **Business \& Operational Excellence**
* Transformation and automation
* Risk assessment and control design
* Program management
* Data\-driven decision making
* Process optimization
* **Stakeholder Management**
* Executive communication
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Global relationship management
* Regulatory engagement readiness

 **Job Expectations:**

* **Role Summary**


The Senior Compliance Manager – Global Surveillance Oversight (GSO) will serve as the lead surveillance risk management officer for the India\-based Global Surveillance Oversight function, providing strategic leadership, governance, and oversight across multiple surveillance domains, including Trade Surveillance, Electronic Communications Surveillance and Voice Surveillance.


This role is accountable for leading and driving the evolution of India GSO Team. The position requires a highly experienced compliance leader capable of balancing regulatory risk management, operational execution, stakeholder engagement, and transformation initiatives across multiple jurisdictions.


The role will act as a senior partner to global GSO stakeholders, ensuring surveillance frameworks remain effective, scalable, regulator\-ready, and aligned to evolving regulatory expectations.

**Strategic Leadership \& Governance**
* Provide strategic leadership for the Global Surveillance Oversight (GSO) program across multiple surveillance pillars and jurisdictions.
* Drive the development and execution of the GSO strategy, aligning with global compliance and risk objectives.
* Ensure consistency of surveillance standards, governance frameworks, operating procedures, and escalation protocols across regions.
* Act as the single point of accountability for surveillance risk oversight within the India organization.
* Partner with global leadership teams to shape the future\-state GSO operating model.
* **Surveillance Oversight**


Lead and oversee GSO activities across:
* Trade Surveillance
* Electronic Communications (E\-Comms) Surveillance
* Voice Surveillance
* Key responsibilities include:
* Ensuring effective GSO coverage and risk\-based monitoring frameworks.
* Overseeing alert review quality, escalation processes, and investigative outcomes.
* Identifying surveillance gaps and implementing appropriate controls.
* Providing credible challenge and review of surveillance methodologies and risk assessments.
* Monitoring regulatory developments and assessing impact on surveillance programs.
* **Regulatory \& Audit Readiness**
* Maintain surveillance programs that meet regulatory expectations across multiple jurisdictions, including SEC, FCA, and other applicable regulatory bodies.
* Lead regulatory examination readiness efforts, including drafting responses to regulator inquiries, audits, reviews, and thematic assessments.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, evidence retention, governance reporting, and control effectiveness.
* Partner with Compliance Testing, Internal Audit, and Risk functions to address findings and drive sustainable remediation.
* **Transformation \& Innovation**
* Lead strategic transformation initiatives focused on automation, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled surveillance capabilities, and process optimization.
* Drive simplification and modernization of surveillance workflows and operating models.
* Identify opportunities to improve effectiveness, efficiency, scalability, and risk coverage through technology and data solutions.
* Sponsor and oversee work migration initiatives and operational transitions into India.
* Build capabilities that support the long\-term GSO vision.
* **Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior Compliance and Risk leadership.
* Present surveillance outcomes, key risks, metrics, and strategic initiatives to senior management forums.
* **People Leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop the team with multiple surveillance disciplines.
* Establish a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Build succession pipelines and strengthen technical expertise across the function.
* Promote employee engagement, capability development, and leadership growth.
* Ensure effective capacity \& resource planning, workload prioritization, and performance management.
* **Risk Management \& Controls**
* Maintain robust governance and control frameworks supporting GSO activities.
* Ensure timely identification, escalation, and mitigation of surveillance\-related risks.
* Drive continuous improvement in quality assurance, metrics, reporting, and monitoring processes.
* Support enterprise compliance initiatives related to market abuse.

**Posting End Date:**


17 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.
